title: AR verifier sanity check
interpretation: Qwen passes the 0.90 sanity AUROC threshold.
Mistral fails the 0.90 sanity AUROC threshold, primarily because of weak math discrimination.
The overall sanity gate fails because every verifier must pass.
These are scoring sanity-check results, not final research evidence.
provenance_note: Overall values are from the completed BF16+SDPA run supplied by the team; math/code values are the reported domain breakdowns.
